deadline_text: Timeline page (table headed 'Date (UK time)'), as read on 19 October 2026: '20 October 2026 | Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program applications open – Eligible applicants are invited to apply. Must complete the Applicant Declaration Form by 19th October.'; '26 October 2026, 5pm | Applicant Declaration Form closes. The form may close earlier once we have reached the limit.'; '19 November 2026, 5pm | Postgraduate Assessment and Scholarship Main Application forms close.' FAQ: 'Receive an invitation to apply (from Survey Monkey Apply) from 20 October ... Complete the Applicant Declaration Form by 26 October 2026, 5pm UK time. Complete and submit the Main Application by 19 November 2026, 5pm UK time.' The earlier timeline (read 12 October) had the declaration form opening 13 October and closing 19 October 2026, 5pm.
deadline_timezone: UK time (GMT on 26 October 2026, after clocks change on 25 October)
potential_issues: The mandatory information sessions (15-24 September 2026) are over; per the FAQ, anyone who did not attend 'will not be eligible to receive an invitation to apply'

The timeline was changed since 12 October: invitations now go out from 20 October and the declaration form closes 26 October 2026, 5pm UK time, but the 20 October row still says 'Must complete the Applicant Declaration Form by 19th October' (contradictory, probably a leftover)
The declaration form 'may close earlier once we have reached the limit'
Degree grade not recorded; 'the equivalent of a UK Second Class (Upper) Bachelor's (Hons) degree or higher' is generally needed
Degree certificate and official final transcript must be uploaded by 19 November 2026
The timeline 'is subject to change depending on the volume of applications received'
The on-campus programme list on the official page carries no year and is 'subject to change'
action: Only if you attended a September information session: watch for the Survey Monkey Apply invitation from 20 October, complete the Applicant Declaration Form as early as possible (closes 26 October 2026, 5pm UK time, or earlier if the limit is reached), then the main forms by 19 November. Choose a listed MSc such as Entrepreneurship and Innovation.

potential_issues: Only for learners with a forced displacement background
The RLRH/Oxford Refugee Studies Centre pages and the Google Form could not be read (403 / login required); details come from UNHCR Rwanda's republication of the call
Re-check on 19 October 2026 failed: the UNHCR Rwanda page and the RSC news page both returned HTTP 403 (bot check), so the 25 October deadline was not re-confirmed
Mentorship only: it does not itself fund study
